explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Orléans (1563)" (revision 1380766837) says: "As a result the captive Louis, Prince of Condé and Anne de Montmorency at Catherine de' Medici's direction were able to negotiate a compromise end to the first war in the Edict of Amboise." The edge reads that sentence as: Siege of Orléans (1563) made Edict of Amboise possible, and nothing more.
